inspiration: Trigger as an event filter and relay: a volume or listener checks what touched it (an NPC, the player, or another object), checks whether it reacts to that kind of event, then relays to a target. It can be enabled and disabled at runtime (docs/engine/objects/zCTrigger.md lines 16-18). For us: a zone volume that tells a spawn or NPC director when a player enters.

Touch damage as a timed volume: damage applies to what sits inside, with a repeat delay, a volume scale for the impact sound, and a collision type (src/vobs/Misc.cc lines 198-212, VTouchDamage::load). A zone hazard built as data, with the tick telegraphed by visuals.
Carryable props: a movable object can be moved or carried (docs/engine/objects/oCMOB.yml line 6). Useful for world props and loot pick-up flow, readable as a simple silhouette at 375 wide.

Class-by-class catalogue with versions: each object class lists its properties, their types and version IDs in YAML (docs/engine/objects/*.yml). A model for our catalogue-as-runtime-source (rows 20-21).

Versioned object parsers: each class's parse and load functions take a game-version argument (src/vobs/Misc.cc line 194 for VTouchDamage::parse), so one loader serves several versions of the same format. Only the idea is useful; the binary format itself is not ours to copy.

Zone-scoped fog, music and far-plane volumes exist as separate classes (names in docs/engine/objects: zCZoneZFog, oCZoneMusic, zCZoneVobFarPlane). Zone atmosphere as data, one volume per effect. Doc names only; not read.

briefs.label: Pressure-plate hazard (timed damage volume)
briefs.why: A floor hazard that ticks while you stand in it is readable at 375 wide if the rim pulses before each tick. One signature sound per tick makes it feel dangerous without new art.
briefs.keep: Damage applies only while inside, on a repeat delay, with a volume scale for the impact sound and a collision type. Signature effect: a short tick sound and a red rim flash.
briefs.change: Telegraph each tick with a rising rim pulse that finishes a beat before damage. Use a different hazard style (gas, spikes or rising water, not fire). Keep all numbers in zone data, never in code.

briefs.label: Relay trigger (filtered volume that tells a target)
briefs.why: One volume that reports entry by a chosen kind of actor drives a whole encounter. Lets a zone designer wire a fight start without script code.
briefs.keep: Two checks (who touched it, whether this trigger reacts to that kind of event), then a relay to a target. Enable and disable at runtime.
briefs.change: Name our events for combat (enter, leave, hit, clear) and keep a per-zone target list. The relay goes to the spawn director, not to a script.

briefs.label: Carryable crate
briefs.why: A prop the player can pick up and move gives small physical play. A crate silhouette reads at 375 wide with a bold outline.
briefs.keep: A prop class with a move-or-carry flag; a simple pick-up state.
briefs.change: Our own silhouettes (sack, barrel, lantern) and a weight rule that slows the carrier. No shared art.
